detail.longDescription: Notion gives your projects, notes, and databases a home. Getting information into it is the hard part: things like the task someone mentions in Slack, an event on your calendar, or a form response you'd rather not retype. Equally important is getting things out of Notion and into all the other apps you use. The easiest way to handle all this is to automate Notion from inside the AI tool you already use. Add Zapier to any AI assistant, describe what should land in Notion (or get sent from Notion)
